issues.description: Many candidates were previously excluded solely because their cell types fell outside the Schwann/neuroendocrine scope; under the new scope-neutral rule, formal markers for all cell types are included.
CADM cannot be resolved to a unique gene (CADM1-CADM4); left as unresolved rather than forced to a single symbol.
No missing-marker baseline issue: the paper reports 80 final cell types/states, and the cluster inventory covers all major subclustering layers reported in the text/figures.
